secrets.name: APP_SECRET
secrets.description: Platform-managed master secret that encrypts provider API keys saved from the in-app admin dashboard. The app boots without it, but saved keys are then rejected.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Google AI Studio key (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) that unlocks Veo video and Imagen stills. Without it the router uses the built-in local renderer.

secrets.name: RUNWAY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Runway API key (https://dev.runwayml.com) that unlocks Gen-4 models. Without it the router uses the built-in local renderer.

secrets.name: KLING_ACCESS_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Kling AI access key (https://app.klingai.com/global/dev) that unlocks Kling 2.1 models. Needs KLING_SECRET_KEY as well.

secrets.name: KLING_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Kling AI secret key paired with KLING_ACCESS_KEY.
